**Goal `coverage-depth` — Stage 4 (per-test lines) is on disk; Stage 5 (VS Code's coverage view) is next.** ADR 0273 is the goal's one record; no further ADR slot is owed.

Stages 1-3 (functions, Cobertura, branches) shipped earlier; `crate::coverage`'s module doc owns how each is counted and written. Stage 4: `run_suite` in `crates/nvs-cli/src/runner.rs` reads the shared `StmtHits` before and after each test, and `crate::coverage::grew` keeps the statements whose count grew as `Case::reached`. Tests run one at a time, so that is every attempt and every request a `server: true` test sent; fixtures are built before a class's first test and are in no test's list. `json_document` writes `schemaVersion: 3` and a `coverage` object per record (`Sites::reached`) only under a coverage flag; without one the document is version 2 unchanged. `rule:testing/report-formats`, `docs/reference/lang/95-testing.md` and `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md` say so. The module doc's `# Per test` owns the mechanism.

All 17 cases of `cargo test --test test_coverage` pass, including the stage 4 check's three. The human summary line still counts lines only.
